title: How easy was it? A 3-minute question about your recent task with {product}
description: Tell us how much effort your recent task took, so the {team} can remove the steps that slow people down.
audience: Customers who completed a task with {product} in the last 7 days, such as setting up an account, changing a plan or getting help
purpose: Decide which customer task to simplify first by finding where effort is highest and what causes it

welcome.title: How easy was it?
welcome.description:
We're the {team} at {company}. We want every task with {product} to take as little effort as possible, and your answers show us where to start.
• Takes about 3 minutes
• Anonymous: only the {team} sees answers, in summary
• Voluntary: you can stop at any time
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you, that's everything
thank_you.description: We'll use your answers to pick the next task we simplify, and we'll share what changed within a month of {date}. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: Which of these did you most recently do with {product} in the last 7 days?
options: Changed a plan or billing details
Asked for help with a problem

questions.label: How much do you agree or disagree: {company} made it easy for me to get this done.
Roughly how many minutes did it take from start to finish?
How many attempts did it take before it was done?
Did you have to switch channels to finish, for example from chat to phone?
What one change would have made this easier?
